name: @pi-vista/checks
description: Bounded, fail-closed programmatic predicates registered by trusted pi-vista hosts

scripts.prepack: npm run build --workspace=@pi-vista/protocol && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node ../../scripts/run-tests.mjs dist-test .test.js
